data.name: Awra
data.gender_notes: Awra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘awrā’, meaning glowing or radiant. This name represents the inner light and beauty that shines from within a person. The name Awra carries the meaning “Glowing, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Awra usually hope their child will grow to embody glowing, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine light within every human being, reminding us of our inner worth and potential.
data.etymology: Awra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glowing, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awra total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: عورة
in_arabic.long_meaning: العورة في اللغة العربية تعني الستر والحياء والعفاف. وهي مصطلح إسلامي يشير إلى الجزء من الجسم الذي يجب ستره عن الأنظار العامة وفقًا للشريعة الإسلامية. العورة هي مفهوم مهم في الإسلام يرتبط بالحشمة والآداب الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: عورہ
in_urdu.meaning: ستر، حیا، اور عفاف کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: عورہ کا لفظ عربی मूल سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے ستر، حیا، اور عفاف۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، عورہ سے مراد جسم کے وہ حصے ہیں جنہیں عوامی نظروں سے چھپانا ضروری ہے۔ یہ اسلامی شریعت کا ایک اہم پہلو ہے جو مسلمانوں کی زندگی میں حیا اور ستر کے معیار کو طے کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अवरा
in_hindi.meaning: शरीर के हिस्से को ढकना, शर्म, और पवित्रता
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवरा नाम का अर्थ है शरीर के कुछ हिस्सों को ढकना, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण माना जाता है। यह नाम शर्म, पवित्रता और इस्लामी मूल्यों से जुड़ा हुआ है। मुस्लिम समुदाय में, अवरा नाम की लड़कियों से उम्मीद की जाती है कि वे शर्म और पवित्रता के साथ जीवन व्यतीत करेंगी।

in_pashto.name: عورہ
in_pashto.meaning: د ستر، حیا، او عفاف معنی
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې، عورہ د ستر، حیا، او عفاف مطلب دی. دا د افغان او پښتني کلتور او اسلامي شریعت یوه مهمه برخه ده، چې د ښځو د ستر او حیا په اړه خبرې کوي.

in_english.name: Awra
in_english.meaning: Private parts; modesty and dignity in Islam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awra originates from Arabic roots, specifically referring to the private parts of the body that must be covered in Islam. It symbolizes modesty, dignity, and adherence to Islamic values. Historically, the term has been used in Islamic jurisprudence to denote the parts of the body that should be concealed from public view. The name Awra holds significant spiritual meaning, emphasizing the importance of modesty and humility in a Muslim's life.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Awra" holds significant cultural importance in the Middle Eastern and Islamic communities, where it is given to boys and girls as a reminder of the inner glory and radiance that each individual possesses. In many Middle Eastern cultures, children are given names that reflect the values and ideals that their parents wish to instill in them, and "Awra" is a name that symbolizes the beauty and brilliance that lies within every person.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Awra" is a reminder of the inner light and beauty that each person carries within them. In Islamic teachings, it is believed that every human being is created in the image of Allah, and as such, possesses an inherent worth and dignity. The name "Awra" serves as a reminder of this truth and encourages individuals to cultivate the inner virtues that contribute to their spiritual growth and development.
